purpose: Credit-consumption benchmark of the Phase 3 loop roles (orchestrator / builder / reviewer) on a real-size project fixture. Prompts live in prompts/*.md; {{PROJECT_ROOT}}, {{SKILL_DIR}}, {{AGENTS_DIR}}, {{TOOLKIT}}, {{CARRIED}} and {{FILE:name}} are filled by tools/bench/run_bench.py.

evals.name: S0-turn-start
evals.prompt: Orchestrator turn start on a raw user instruction (fix Slide 030 per Phase 4 findings): route, read state, prepare the builder dispatch, stop before dispatching.
evals.expected_output: Routes to workflows/phase3-slide-review.md, names Slide 030, lists only the applicable carried-forward rules, states the review_state update, and returns a key/value builder dispatch without transcribing source text.
assertions: Output names workflows/phase3-slide-review.md as the chosen route
Output contains a builder dispatch with the contract keys PROJECT_ROOT, MODE, SLIDE, STORYBOARD, SOURCES and CARRIED
No builder or reviewer agent was launched (no Agent/Task tool use in the transcript)
No slides/deck.pptx was created in the run copy
The dispatch does not transcribe source verbatims (none of the known SRC-002/003/006/028 quote fragments appear)

evals.name: S1-reviewer-dispatch
evals.prompt: Orchestrator writes the iteration-2 dispatch for techdeck-slide-reviewer on Slide 030 (same shape as the 2026-10-13 pressure test S1).
evals.expected_output: A self-contained key/value dispatch (MODE, PROJECT_ROOT, SLIDE, PNG, STORYBOARD, SOURCES, RUBRIC, VISUAL, CARRIED, PRIOR, ITERATION) that references the index instead of quoting source text and does not summarise the builder's claims as facts.
assertions: Dispatch contains the reviewer contract keys MODE, PROJECT_ROOT, SLIDE, PNG, STORYBOARD, SOURCES, RUBRIC, VISUAL, CARRIED, PRIOR and ITERATION
The dispatch does not transcribe source verbatims (none of the known SRC-002/003/006/028 quote fragments appear)
The dispatch passes the review-rubric path (review-rubric.md) and the visual-design path (visual-design.md)
The dispatch does not instruct the reviewer to approve (no 'APPROVED にして' / 'approve the slide' instruction)

evals.name: S3-builder-fix
evals.prompt: Builder FIX, iteration 2, Slide 030, three prior findings, carried-forward rules inline, no deck available (describe the BUILD RESULT).
evals.expected_output: A single ## BUILD RESULT block with a disposition for each of FINDING-001..003, Character count with 'Not counted', Deviations from spec, Fit, Impact, Points requiring user confirmation, Progress file; FINDING-001 is not pushed back.
assertions: Response begins with a ## BUILD RESULT block
Finding dispositions table has one row for each of FINDING-001, FINDING-002 and FINDING-003 with a disposition in {FIXED, PUSHED_BACK, PARTIAL, NEEDS_USER}
FINDING-001 (lifecycle-aware collection missing) is not PUSHED_BACK
### Character count section present with a 'Not counted' list
### Deviations from spec section present
### Progress file section present
Response does not declare the slide APPROVED

evals.name: S4-reviewer-slide
evals.prompt: Reviewer MODE: slide, iteration 2, Slide 030 with rendered PNG, prior findings plus builder dispositions, carried-forward rules inline, no deck available.
evals.expected_output: A single ## REVIEW RESULT block with the header lines, a status for each prior finding, any new findings with Severity/Category/Rubric/Status, and ### R6 notes; verdict from the review namespace only.
assertions: Response begins with a ## REVIEW RESULT block
Header lines present: Slide, Iteration, Overall result, Counts, Rubric items failed, 3-second takeaway, Cold-read summary, Body chars
Overall result is one of PASS, PASS_WITH_MINOR_FIXES, REVISION_REQUIRED, BLOCKED
Each of FINDING-001, FINDING-002 and FINDING-003 is addressed with a Status line
Every new finding section has Severity, Category, Rubric and Status lines; prior findings (001-003) at least a Status line
### R6 notes section present
Verdict is not BLOCKED and APPROVED is never emitted as a verdict
